definitions.explanation: An item of excellent quality or historical significance, renowned for its craftsmanship or artistic value. Often used in the context of art, antiques, traditional crafts, and gourmet food.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名品|めいひん}だ。
examples.english: This tea bowl is a renowned masterpiece.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名品|めいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: An exhibition gathering fine articles from various regions will be held.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国宝級|こくほうきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名品|めいひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦{所蔵|しょぞう}→所蔵：12889_shozou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This museum houses many fine pieces of national treasure caliber.

notes:
Refers to items that are widely recognized for their excellence — whether works of art, traditional crafts, gourmet specialties, or luxury goods. The word emphasizes fame and recognition of quality. Often used in department store promotions (⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧{名品|めいひん}⟦{展|てん}→〜展：28468_ten⟧, exhibition of fine products from across Japan) and museum contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名品|めいひん}⟦{展|てん}→〜展：28468_ten⟧ — exhibition of fine articles
- ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名品|めいひん} — fine products from across the country
- {名品|めいひん}ぞろい — a lineup of masterpieces
- {名品|めいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to appreciate fine works

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逸品|いっぴん}→逸品：19463_ippin⟧ — excellent item; emphasizes quality rather than fame; more about personal judgment of excellence
- ⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧ — masterpiece; typically used for creative works (art, literature, film)
- {銘品|めいひん} — also read めいひん, written with a different first character; refers to famous branded products, often local specialties
